title: Your Typing Rhythm Is a Digital Fingerprint

vo.en: You are tracked by how you type.

visual.description: Macro close-up of a man's fingers hitting mechanical keyboard keys rapidly in a dark room with neon lighting.

vo.en: It’s called keystroke dynamics. AI measures the exact millisecond gap between every single letter you press on your device.

visual.description: High-speed digital timer counting milliseconds rapidly against a black background with glowing data streams.

vo.en: Even if you are anonymous or using a VPN, your unique rhythm is as distinct as a DNA sample.

visual.description: A digital fingerprint scan transforming into a complex web of code and connecting lines.

vo.en: But here is the creepy part.

visual.description: A man in a hoodie looking intensely at a glowing computer monitor in a dark room.

vo.en: AI identifies you with ninety-nine percent accuracy just by monitoring the beat of your fingers on a screen or keyboard.

visual.description: A data visualization showing a percentage counter climbing rapidly to 99% with green glowing text.

vo.en: Banks and security firms already use this to fingerprint your identity without you ever realizing it happened.

visual.description: A shadowy male silhouette walking through a high-tech server room with blinking blue lights.

vo.en: Comment your typing speed and subscribe for more digital secrets because...

visual.description: A hand holding a smartphone scrolling quickly through a social media feed.
